_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With macro hedging signals (gold at 95, VIX at 69) conflicting with crypto-native momentum and no base rate available from thin score history, the coiled spring could resolve either way — HOLD is the honest call until ETF flows or CVD confirm a directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call HOLD on direction, but the Analyst sees stalling/distribution risk while the Narrative sees constructive accumulation awaiting a spark; the split is on interpretation of the same coiled setup.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows break above 85 with funding climbing past 65 and VIX compressing below 50, signaling the analog is re-asserting and a Thrill leg is beginning.
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC exchange reserves pct 30d drops below 70 with CVD staying at 0 and retail noise velocity failing to lift above 50, confirming distribution and risking a slide to Disbelief.
